test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ________ of the novel kept me hooked from the beginning to the end.
solution: The correct answer is '**plot**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "**plot**" refers to the main storyline or narrative of a novel, which is central to keeping readers engaged. • In this context, the plot of the novel is described as captivating and engaging. • The other options: "**archaic**," "**settlement**," and "**orchestra**" do not fit appropriately in the sentence. ​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'. **Complete Sentence:** *The plot__ of the novel kept me hooked from the beginning to the end.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Archaic (प्राचीन)**: means very old or outdated. • **Settlement (समझौता)**: refers to an agreement or a place where people establish a community. • **Orchestra (संगीतमंडली)**: refers to a group of musicians playing together. 197:T47e,
